choices.why: Low, boxy three-seater in a soft beige-grey fabric with clean lines; the calm, simple sofa the user described for the right wall.
The 160x230 cm natural jute rug is large enough to anchor both sofa and coffee table and adds warm, textured fiber over the dark grey floor.
Low, round walnut coffee table, exactly the round wooden piece requested, with a warm grain that ties to the jute rug.
Tall rice-paper column lamp, the paper lantern the user asked for, giving soft diffused light in the corner by the sofa.

The ZZ plant is the only tall, leafy option with real presence beside the balcony glass and suits a minimal, low-maintenance space, though it comes in a plastic nursery pot rather than the ceramic one requested.

answer.why: A low beige sofa, jute rug, round walnut table and paper lantern keep to a restrained palette of neutrals and natural textures, warming the white walls and dark floor in a serene Japandi way. The ZZ plant brings in a single touch of green by the balcony; for the requested ceramic look, set its nursery pot inside the beige pot (702.858.58), checking the size first.
